articles.title: Strategy says MSCI should measure markets, not dictate corporate assets
articles.snippet: The bitcoin treasury company said index providers should measure markets rather than determine which assets public companies are allowed to own.

articles.title: RedotPay said to put $1 billion U.S. IPO plan on hold: Bloomberg
articles.snippet: A spokesperson for the stablecoin payments company declined to comment on any IPO plans.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders Strategy and Metaplanet face stock-index exclusion under MSCI’s new proposal
articles.snippet: A new consultation targets "non-operating companies" broadly. Two familiar names still land on the deletion list.

articles.title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
articles.snippet: KPMG U.S. examined Tether's books and even counted its gold bars as the $180 billion USDT issuer said it completed its long-promised financial audit.

articles.title: Bullish shares surge 14% as subscription revenue offsets digital asset slowdown
articles.snippet: Bullish's second-quarter loss of $280 million was mostly attributable to a $244.6 million markdown on the company’s bitcoin holdings.
